skills.description_zh: Distill Chinese medicine classics (黄帝内经/伤寒论/金匮要略/本草/医案/温病/针灸等) into a diagnosis-decision system with built-in safety boundaries. Use when the user asks to "蒸馏一本中医书" / "把 XX 医书做成 skill" / "拆解《伤寒论》" / "把《黄帝内经》蒸馏成 skill" — i.e. wants to turn a TCM book into an executable syndrome-differentiation (辨证) system an agent can invoke, NOT for simple summarization or book reviews, and NOT for writing real prescriptions.
skills.name: 神农中医蒸馏
